__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

insertBarcode.description: Confirms a barcode for an item without a proposal. Confirming one the item already has returns it.

confirmBarcodeProposal.description: Confirms a store's proposal, so the barcode reaches every site. With no packaging variant or item variant given, it goes on the item's auto-created variant for the proposal's manufacturer.

deleteBarcode.description: Removes the barcode from a packaging variant, everywhere. `id` is the packaging variant's. The removal is remembered, so the barcode isn't auto-confirmed for the item again. An auto-created variant left with no barcode is deleted; confirming the barcode again brings it back.
